title: Loan & Auto Loan Methodology
overview: Loan calculations use the same PMT formula as mortgages but typically involve shorter terms and different rate structures. Auto loans commonly range from 24-84 months.

methods.name: Standard Amortizing Loan
methods.description: Fixed monthly payments where each payment covers interest first, then principal. The interest portion decreases over time while principal portion increases.
limitations: Does not include fees or add-ons
methods.bestFor: Personal loans, auto loans, standard financing

methods.name: Simple Interest Loan
methods.description: Interest calculated only on the outstanding principal, not compounded. Common for auto loans and some personal loans.

methods.name: Balloon Payment Loan
methods.description: Lower monthly payments with a large lump sum due at the end. Risky but can work for those planning to refinance or sell.

formula.name: Balloon Loan Structure
formula.expression:
Monthly Payment = Interest-only or reduced amortization
Balloon = Remaining balance at term end
formula.description: Final payment can be 20-80% of original loan

limitations: Risk of not being able to pay balloon

sources.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau - Auto Loans

footnotes: Auto loan rates depend heavily on credit score and loan-to-value ratio
New car loans typically have lower rates than used car loans
Longer terms mean lower payments but more total interest
Consider gap insurance for new vehicles
disclaimer: Loan calculations are estimates. Actual rates depend on creditworthiness, vehicle age, and lender policies. Shop multiple lenders for best rates.
